name: greerviau
description: Reusable agent skills for engineering and scientific research, one installable plugin per category.

plugins.name: greerviau-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering skills: planning, GitHub development workflows, test-driven development, bug diagnosis, design spikes, pull requests and issues, review, refactoring, merge-conflict resolution, doc audits, mermaid diagrams, conversation handoffs, and session retrospectives.

plugins.name: greerviau-general
plugins.description: General skills: browser-based document review with inline comments, plain writing across domains, multi-session teaching from vetted sources, visual demonstrations, and scientific-literature research backed by OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, and Crossref.
